candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Test Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated desktop pet visibility verification screen after home intro to ensure the pet renders properly on the user's screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 complaints about pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open, and the finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_visibility_test.headline: Desktop Pet Visibility Check
new_visibility_test.body: Can you see your pet floating on your desktop right now? Confirm display settings if hidden.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new setup verification screen after the home intro within onboarding while preserving all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% with 3 rendering complaints, but adding a new screen increases overall friction.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring mascot animations and an official badge.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is low at 60.9% with a very long mean duration of 1017s.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop friend is officially registered! Review details and bring them home.

guard.reason: Replaces the official stamp on the adoption certificate with a general badge, losing the required official stamp job.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Recovery Notice
candidates.change: Displays an account sync reassurance hint on the sign-in screen informing returning users that their pets will restore.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously adopted desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adds account recovery copy to the sign-in screen without violating any onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; simple text hint reassurance is low cost and high confidence.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Selector Redesign
candidates.change: Replaces standard path selection layout with a story_scroll format with preview cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet
choose_path.body: Scroll through path options: pick a preset companion or create a custom pet from photos.

guard.reason: Redesigns path selection layout while preserving options for both preset adoption and custom pet creation.

candidates.score_note: Large gap between mean (514s) and median (8s) duration on choose_path, but layout redesign requires major effort without support complaints.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Live Status Feedback
candidates.change: Replaces the default photo upload area with an interactive live sprite preview and tip carousel.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, causing drop-offs during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: We are analyzing photo lighting and contours to build a high-quality 3D desktop sprite.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Checklist Screen
candidates.change: Adds an interactive checklist screen at the end of onboarding detailing shortcuts and mouse controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling/hiding pets and 4 emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior.

new_controls_checklist.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Start Checklist
new_controls_checklist.body: Learn the essential mouse gestures and shortcuts to manage your pet on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a valid controls checklist screen after the home intro while preserving all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish is a major drop-off point (35.2%) with 7 related support emails, though a full screen adds friction.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Ambient Sound and Stage Flow
candidates.change: Transforms the waiting screen into an ambient stage layout with calm sound and smooth visual progress indicators.
candidates.why: The home waiting screen has a massive mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing high drop-offs prior to completion.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Relax while your companion's animations, voice tones, and movement AI load in background.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen layout while continuing to convey that the pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Extreme mean time (2336s) at home waiting stage, but complex visual/audio ambient flow requires new release.

candidates.title: Sign-In Status Connection Badge
candidates.change: Adds a network status badge and explicit system connectivity confirmation to the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen not appearing or the app stalling right before sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress
sign_in.body: Connect your account to sync pet data across desktop devices instantly.

guard.reason: Adds network status messaging to the sign-in screen without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Only 2 support complaints; sign_in step loses 20%, minor badge UI change.

candidates.title: Story Screen Spotlight Demo Video
candidates.change: Upgrades the story screen to a spotlight layout featuring an animated preview video of pets in action.
candidates.why: Initial conversion from story to path selection is only 76.2% with a long mean time.

story.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy
story.body: Watch a quick preview of how virtual pets live on your desktop while you work.

guard.reason: Upgrades the story screen to a spotlight layout while continuing to introduce the desktop pet.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 23.8% with long decision time; video preview aids clarity but requires layout and video assets.

candidates.title: Completion Accessory Gift Incentive
candidates.change: Promotes an exclusive starter pet accessory unlock on the home intro screen upon completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion rate is low at 19.6%, with a final conversion step drop-off to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Onboarding Complete - Special Gift Unlocked!
home_intro.body: You unlocked an exclusive starter accessory for your desktop pet. Click finish to place them on your screen.

guard.reason: Promotes gifts and free accessory unlocks in onboarding copy, violating the pricing and copy restriction.

picked: Waiting Screen Ambient Sound and Stage Flow

decisions.title: Waiting Screen Ambient Sound and Stage Flow
